key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0C44
name: lookup_table_scaled_by_nine
description: Adds a byte from a global table, indexed by the input register, to a second input byte, multiplies the sum by nine, and returns the byte found at that offset in a fixed lookup table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0C78
name: copy_record_fields_to_globals
description: Copies two 16-bit words and two single bytes from the record at A0 into four fixed global locations, then sets the global control byte to one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0CC2
name: set_indexed_bits_and_dispatch
description: Sets fixed status bits in the structure at A2 and in a word indexed by D0, then, when a global counter exceeds a threshold, calls subroutines according to a byte value: three calls for one code and one call for another.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0CC8
name: set_indexed_flag_and_dispatch
description: Sets status bits in a word indexed by D0 and, when a global counter exceeds a threshold, calls subroutines according to a byte value: three calls for one code and one call for another.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0CCE
name: conditional_dispatch_on_threshold
description: When a global counter exceeds a threshold, calls subroutines according to a byte value: three calls for one code and one call for another.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D02
name: call_then_clear_flag_bit
description: Calls a subroutine, then clears bit zero of the byte at offset five in the record reached through A2.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D12
name: call_then_set_flag_bit
description: Calls a subroutine, then sets bit zero of the byte at offset five in the record reached through A2.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D22
name: call_then_toggle_flag_bit
description: Calls a subroutine, then inverts bit zero of the byte at offset five in the record reached through A2.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D3E
name: step_toward_target_coordinates
description: Advances a stepwise movement state held in global bytes, comparing current and target coordinate words against a direction bit pattern and step counter, updates the flag byte of a record, and calls several subroutines to apply each step.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0FD6
name: stub_return_only
description: The recovered body is a bare return with no work, so this is a stub; the listed instruction count is not reflected in the pseudo-code.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:10C4
name: store_coords_and_derive_offset
description: Stores two input words into the record at A0, then computes a third word from a base field minus a second field scaled by a sixth of a value derived from the second input, and writes it back into the same record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1164
name: store_offset_fields_with_flag
description: Clears the high bit of a flag byte in a record, sets it and subtracts four when the input byte exceeds four, then stores the resulting value plus twenty-four into three record bytes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1190
name: step_point_to_free_cell
description: Steps one point toward a target in increments taken from two record bytes, repeating while the bitmap cell it lands on is occupied, and returns the final coordinates.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:120E
name: select_nearest_unmarked_entries
description: Computes the Manhattan distance from a point to each three-word entry of a global table, then repeatedly selects the nearest entry not yet marked in a bitmask byte of the record, calling subroutines for each selection.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1306
name: set_step_sizes_walk_path
description: Computes the absolute x and y offsets between two points, stores per-axis step sizes into two record bytes based on which offset dominates, then walks the point toward the target until it reaches a free cell.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1352
name: halve_step_sizes_below_threshold
description: Sets a flag byte to one in the record at A0 and, when a record word is below a threshold, calls a subroutine; if the word is also below a lower threshold, it halves both step-size bytes in the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:136A
name: halve_two_step_bytes
description: Shifts two record bytes at offsets twenty-four and twenty-five right by one bit, halving them, and returns the input value unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1384
name: probe_spiral_for_blocked_cell
description: Walks outward in a spiral from a start cell, testing bitmap bits inside a 252 by 228 area, and returns the input pair as soon as it finds an occupied cell; it gives up after a fixed step limit, and returns early when a global flag is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1430
name: mark_matching_slots_removed
description: Marks every entry of a terminated three-byte-record table whose first byte matches the input byte as removed, then updates two record fields and clears a flag bit in another record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1458
name: restore_removed_slots_with_byte
description: Walks the same terminated three-byte table and writes the input byte into every slot previously marked as removed, then calls two subroutines if any slot was restored.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1486
name: reset_flags_and_select_positions
description: Clears bit four in every eighth byte of a region, then selects one of three position word pairs according to a global state value and sets a flag bit in two records, and when the state equals three it zeroes a run of 43 long-word slots before setting bits in another record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1522
name: call_then_set_record_bits
description: Calls a subroutine, then sets bits three and two in the byte at offset thirteen of the record at A0.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1546
name: set_state_after_subroutine_calls
description: Runs several subroutine calls, sets a record byte to four when a global state equals ten, sets bit two in another record byte, and when the state equals minus two calls a routine and sets a further flag bit; it then stores fixed constants in globals and sets the state to two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:15BA
name: double_table_entry_plus_offset
description: Looks up a byte in the global table at an index formed from the second input byte plus one hundred fifty-two, doubles it, and returns that value added to the first input word.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:15D8
name: dispatch_command_byte_handlers
description: Selects a branch by comparing an input command byte against many values, updating global state and flag bits and calling subroutines in each branch; one path steps through a byte sequence ended by a value of 255, calling a routine for each byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1B16
name: toggle_flag_bit_then_call
description: Calls a subroutine, inverts bit zero of the byte the A0 pointer refers to, then calls another subroutine with that same pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2098
name: store_three_values_with_calls
description: Stores the values twenty-nine, thirty and twenty-nine into the byte at offset fifty-four of successive records, calling subroutines between the stores.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:20BC
name: call_then_halt_forever
description: Calls a subroutine and then loops forever with no exit, so control never returns to the caller.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:20CC
name: call_then_toggle_record_flag
description: Calls a subroutine, then inverts bit zero of the byte at offset five in a record reached through a global pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:20DE
name: busy_wait_until_word_zero
description: Clears a global flag, then spins until the input word reaches zero before returning.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2106
name: reset_state_and_record_defaults
description: When the global state byte is neither zero nor four, resets it to zero, calls subroutines and clears bit zero of a record byte; it then clears bit seven of another record byte and sets three record bytes to the value twenty-eight.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:213E
name: set_flag_then_idle_forever
description: Sets bit zero in the record at A0, calls two subroutines, and loops without exit; the routine references the text THE END.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2230
name: toggle_loop_or_update_state
description: When the input byte is below thirty-two, it sets global values, copies a block of six long words, then loops indefinitely toggling a flag and counting to fifteen between toggles; otherwise it compares a table byte with a global state and, when they differ, updates the state and calls subroutines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2282
name: call_pair_then_loop_forever
description: Calls two subroutines and then loops without exit, so it never returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:232C
name: copy_position_and_flip_flags
description: Swaps flag bit zero between two records, copies the position words at offsets fourteen and sixteen from one record to the other, sets the word at offset thirty-eight to one thousand, and sets a state byte to zero then one with subroutine calls in between.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:239A
name: set_state_copy_record_fields
description: Calls subroutines and sets the global state byte to one, then shifts the byte at offset thirteen of one record left by two and ORs it with its original value, copies the word at offset fourteen to another record, and clears bit zero of a flag byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:23C4
name: shift_copy_fields_between_records
description: Shifts the byte at offset thirteen of one record left by two and ORs it with its original value, copies the word at offset fourteen to two other records, and clears bit zero of a flag byte in one of them.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:23FA
name: search_table_for_byte_value
description: Scans a terminated table of three-byte records, comparing the third byte of each record with the input byte, and returns as soon as a match is found.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2418
name: append_entry_and_update_count
description: Calls a subroutine, writes the value 254 into a byte two before A0, stores the input byte in a table at the current counter index, sets a companion byte to the counter minus six or zero, and increments the counter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2446
name: remove_table_entry_by_value
description: Calls a subroutine and clears a byte two before A0, then searches a byte table for the input value; when found, it shifts the following entries down by one, decrements the counter and adjusts a companion byte, otherwise it returns unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:248C
name: call_then_shift_copy_fields
description: Calls a subroutine, then shifts the byte at offset thirteen of one record left by two and ORs it with its original value, copies the word at offset fourteen to two other records, and clears bit zero of a flag byte in one of them.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2494
name: clear_state_and_flag
description: Clears bit four of the global state byte and bit zero of the byte at offset five of a record, then calls a subroutine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:24B0
name: reset_record_then_write_bytes
description: Calls a subroutine, clears bit zero of a record flag byte and the byte at offset thirteen, then writes the byte values sixty-five and sixty-six into offset three of two successive records, calling a subroutine between the writes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:24B4
name: reset_record_then_write_bytes
description: Calls a subroutine, clears bit zero of a record flag byte and the byte at offset thirteen, then writes the byte values sixty-five and sixty-six into offset three of two successive records, calling a subroutine between the writes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2508
name: unpack_checked_bitstream_block
description: Checks a four-byte signature at the start of a loaded block, reads width and height fields, allocates a buffer and fills a 256-byte table, then decodes a control-byte stream in which set bits copy an earlier span of output and clear bits copy a literal byte; failures store codes one to four.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2528
name: blit_rows_with_blitter_registers
description: Waits for the Amiga blitter, programs its control, mask, modulo and size registers, then for each row computes source and destination positions and starts a blit through the graphics library vectors, choosing an offset from a flag value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2554
name: init_records_and_timed_waits
description: Initializes a series of records with fixed word values until a subroutine returns zero, then runs nested loops that call subroutines and busy-wait on counter values before returning.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:26E6
name: copy_table_then_toggle_loop
description: Stores the input byte, calls subroutines according to the stored value, copies a block of six long words, and then loops indefinitely toggling a flag and counting to fifteen between toggles.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28C2
name: free_counted_memory_blocks
description: Calls the exec library FreeMem vector once for each step of a countdown that starts at the input word and ends below zero, so it frees one more block than the input value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28E2
name: allocate_and_convert_bitplanes
description: Allocates three buffers through the exec AllocMem vector and stores their pointers in a table, then converts four bitplanes into lookup-mapped byte streams: for each bit column it gathers four-bit indices from paired planes, looks each index up in a 16-entry table and writes the results to the output buffers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28E6
name: convert_bitplanes_alias_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code is the same bitplane conversion loop as the routine at the preceding lower address, so it is a second entry into that code rather than separate work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28EA
name: convert_bitplanes_alias_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code is the same bitplane conversion loop as the routine at the preceding lower address, so it is a second entry into that code rather than separate work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28EE
name: convert_bitplanes_alias_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code is the same bitplane conversion loop as the routine at the preceding lower address, so it is a second entry into that code rather than separate work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28F2
name: convert_bitplanes_alias_entry
description: Single-instruction entry whose pseudo-code is the same bitplane conversion loop as the routine at the preceding lower address, so it is a second entry into that code rather than separate work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28F6
name: allocate_and_convert_bitplanes
description: Allocates three buffers through the exec AllocMem vector and stores their pointers in a table, then converts four bitplanes into lookup-mapped byte streams: for each bit column it gathers four-bit indices from paired planes, looks each index up in a 16-entry table and writes the results to the output buffers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:297C
name: build_descending_rank_lookup
description: Derives a count for each of sixteen source words from their byte fields, then over sixteen passes finds the largest remaining count, records its index in a 16-entry lookup table and marks that entry used with the value 255, and finally zeroes four long-word slots.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:29F0
name: update_bitplanes_from_threshold_compare
description: Walks rows of four bitplane words and a byte buffer, comparing bytes from two buffers and, when the absolute difference reaches a threshold, increments the byte and uses a four-bit lookup table to set or clear the matching bit in each plane word.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2AA0
name: call_then_clear_handler_slot
description: Calls a subroutine, then clears a handler pointer held in data to zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2AA4
name: call_then_clear_handler_slot
description: Calls a subroutine, then clears a handler pointer held in data to zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2AAE
name: call_then_clear_handler_slot
description: Calls a subroutine, then clears a handler pointer held in data to zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2ABA
name: run_state_wait_sequence
description: Clears bit zero of a record byte and sets a state value to one, optionally calls a subroutine, then loops over subroutine calls and busy-waits on the state value; when it ends at zero it sets bit zero again and the state to two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2AC6
name: run_state_wait_loop_only
description: Sets a state value to one, optionally calls a subroutine, then loops over subroutine calls and busy-waits on the state value; when it ends at zero it sets bit zero of a record byte and the state to two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2B36
name: write_marker_letters_by_state
description: Calls a subroutine, writes the letter N to the byte at A0, then writes the letter D or L at offset three depending on whether the state equals one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2B54
name: check_state_then_idle_forever
description: Clears a state value and calls subroutines, returns early when a global word is nonzero, otherwise toggles a flag, conditionally copies a value and then loops forever without exit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2C08
name: return_fixed_constant_pair
description: Returns a fixed 64-bit constant whose high 32-bit value is thirty-four and low value is forty-six, with no calls or memory writes, so it is a constant-returning stub.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2C24
name: stub_infinite_loop_only
description: Contains only an infinite loop with no calls or exit, so it is a dead-end stub.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2C3A
name: call_then_halt_forever
description: Calls a subroutine and then loops forever with no exit, so control never returns to the caller.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2C72
name: clear_flags_in_three_records
description: Clears bit zero of the byte at offset five in each of three records referenced from a global pointer table, then clears two handler pointers held in data.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2C9C
name: copy_position_words_to_globals
description: Copies the words at offsets fourteen and sixteen of the current record into two fixed global locations.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2CBA
